## Overview

This notebook validates simulation outputs for single-epoch birth-death age sampling,
including population counts and age distributions against theoretical curves.

## Setup

```{python}
# ruff: noqa: E402
# inf_bp_texts must be imported before jax so its JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu default
# (see src/inf_bp_texts/__init__.py) takes effect before jax reads the env var.
import inf_bp_texts  # noqa: F401 — triggers jax_enable_x64  # pyright: ignore[reportUnusedImport]
from typing import Any

import altair as alt
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display
from joblib import Parallel, delayed
from scipy.stats import PermutationMethod, anderson_ksamp, ks_2samp

from inf_bp_texts.analysis import (

    proportion_not_at_upper,

)
from inf_bp_texts.models.math_ages import (

from inf_bp_texts.models.math_populations import calculate_populations_log_pmf
from inf_bp_texts.simulation import (

    simulate_birth_death_lifespans,

)
```

## Simulate Age Vectors

```{python}
num_sims = 5_000
birth_rate = 0.005
death_rate = birth_rate - 0.004
time_span = 1500.0
NOTEBOOK_SEED = (
    42  # fixed seed for reproducibility; used as base for per-simulation seeds
)
population_bin_width = 100


def sample_age_vector_from_distribution(
    seed: int, br: float, dr: float, span: float
) -> np.ndarray:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    sampled = simulate_bdp_ages_from_distributions(
        birth_rate=float(br),
        death_rate=float(dr),
        max_time=float(span),
        rng=rng,
    )
    assert sampled.spine_ages is not None and sampled.non_spine_ages is not None
    return np.asarray(
        sampled.spine_ages.tolist() + sampled.non_spine_ages.tolist(),
        dtype=np.float64,
    )


def sample_age_vector_full_process(
    seed: int, br: float, dr: float, span: float
) -> np.ndarray:
    simulated_df = simulate_birth_death_process(
        birth_rates=float(br),
        death_rates=float(dr),
        times=float(span),
        random_seed=seed,
    )
    survivors = simulated_df.surviving_manuscripts
    assert survivors is not None
    if survivors.empty:
        return np.array([], dtype=np.float64)

    spine_ages = survivors.loc[survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
    non_spine_ages = survivors.loc[~survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    if spine_ages.size > 0:
        return np.concatenate([spine_ages[:1], non_spine_ages]).astype(np.float64)
    return non_spine_ages.astype(np.float64)


# jax.random.split gives an explicit independence guarantee per worker seed,
# unlike sequential-integer seeding.
direct_sampling_seeds = derive_worker_seeds(NOTEBOOK_SEED, num_sims)
full_process_seeds = derive_worker_seeds(NOTEBOOK_SEED + 100_000, num_sims)

direct_sampling_start = time.perf_counter()
list_of_ages_from_distribution = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(sample_age_vector_from_distribution)(
        seed=direct_sampling_seeds[i],
        br=birth_rate,
        dr=death_rate,
        span=time_span,
    )
    for i in range(num_sims)
)
direct_sampling_seconds = time.perf_counter() - direct_sampling_start

full_process_start = time.perf_counter()
list_of_ages_full_process = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(sample_age_vector_full_process)(
        seed=full_process_seeds[i],
        br=birth_rate,
        dr=death_rate,
        span=time_span,
    )
    for i in range(num_sims)
)
full_process_seconds = time.perf_counter() - full_process_start


def sample_age_vector_lifespans(
    seed: int, br: float, dr: float, span: float
) -> np.ndarray:
    simulated_df = simulate_birth_death_lifespans(
        birth_rates=float(br),
        death_rates=float(dr),
        times=float(span),
        random_seed=seed,
    )
    survivors = simulated_df.surviving_manuscripts
    assert survivors is not None
    if survivors.empty:
        return np.array([], dtype=np.float64)

    spine_ages = survivors.loc[survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
    non_spine_ages = survivors.loc[~survivors["is_spine"], "age"].to_numpy(
        dtype=np.float64,
    )

    if spine_ages.size > 0:
        return np.concatenate([spine_ages[:1], non_spine_ages]).astype(np.float64)
    return non_spine_ages.astype(np.float64)


lifespan_seeds = derive_worker_seeds(NOTEBOOK_SEED + 200_000, num_sims)

lifespan_start = time.perf_counter()
list_of_ages_lifespans = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(
    delayed(sample_age_vector_lifespans)(
        seed=lifespan_seeds[i],
        br=birth_rate,
        dr=death_rate,
        span=time_span,
    )
    for i in range(num_sims)
)
lifespan_seconds = time.perf_counter() - lifespan_start

population_sizes_direct = np.asarray(
    [len(ages) for ages in list_of_ages_from_distribution],
    dtype=np.int64,
)
population_sizes_process = np.asarray(
    [len(ages) for ages in list_of_ages_full_process],
    dtype=np.int64,
)
population_sizes_lifespans = np.asarray(
    [len(ages) for ages in list_of_ages_lifespans],
    dtype=np.int64,
)

print(f"Simulations per method: {num_sims}")
print(f"Sampling time (from distribution): {direct_sampling_seconds:.2f}s")
print(f"Sampling time (full process): {full_process_seconds:.2f}s")
print(f"Sampling time (lifespan-at-birth): {lifespan_seconds:.2f}s")
print(f"Mean population (from distribution): {population_sizes_direct.mean():.2f}")
print(f"Mean population (full process): {population_sizes_process.mean():.2f}")
print(f"Mean population (lifespan-at-birth): {population_sizes_lifespans.mean():.2f}")
print(
    f"Extinct fraction (from distribution): {(population_sizes_direct == 0).mean():.3f}"
)
print(f"Extinct fraction (full process): {(population_sizes_process == 0).mean():.3f}")
print(
    f"Extinct fraction (lifespan-at-birth): {(population_sizes_lifespans == 0).mean():.3f}"
)
print(
    f"Theoretical extinct fraction: {calculate_extinction_pr(birth_rate, death_rate, time_span):.3f}"
)
print(
    f"From distribution spine ages count: {sum(1 for ages in list_of_ages_from_distribution if len(ages) > 0 and ages[0] < time_span)}"
)
print(
    f"Full process spine ages count: {sum(1 for ages in list_of_ages_full_process if len(ages) > 0 and ages[0] < time_span)}"
)
print(
    f"Lifespan spine ages count: {sum(1 for ages in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(ages) > 0 and ages[0] < time_span)}"
)
print(
    f"From distribution non-spine ages count: {sum(len(ages) - 1 for ages in list_of_ages_from_distribution if len(ages) > 1)}"
)
print(
    f"Full process non-spine ages count: {sum(len(ages) - 1 for ages in list_of_ages_full_process if len(ages) > 1)}"
)
print(
    f"Lifespan non-spine ages count: {sum(len(ages) - 1 for ages in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(ages) > 1)}"
)
```

## Population Distribution

```{python}
population_max = int(
    max(
        population_sizes_direct.max(),
        population_sizes_process.max(),
        population_sizes_lifespans.max(),
        1,
    ),
)
population_bin_edges = np.arange(
    0,
    population_max + population_bin_width,
    population_bin_width,
    dtype=np.float64,
)
if population_bin_edges[-1] < population_max + 1:
    population_bin_edges = np.append(
        population_bin_edges, population_bin_edges[-1] + population_bin_width
    )
population_bin_centers = (population_bin_edges[:-1] + population_bin_edges[1:]) / 2.0

population_empirical_counts_direct, _ = np.histogram(
    population_sizes_direct,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
)
population_empirical_counts_process, _ = np.histogram(
    population_sizes_process,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
)
population_empirical_counts_lifespans, _ = np.histogram(
    population_sizes_lifespans,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
)

population_support = np.arange(0, population_max + 1, dtype=np.int64)
population_pmf = np.asarray(
    jnp.exp(
        calculate_populations_log_pmf(
            birth_rates=jnp.array([birth_rate]),
            death_rates=jnp.array([death_rate]),
            ns=jnp.array(population_support, dtype=jnp.float64),
            times=jnp.array([time_span]),
        )
    )
)

population_theoretical_counts, _ = np.histogram(
    population_support,
    bins=population_bin_edges,
    weights=population_pmf * num_sims,
)

_pop_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
for bc, cnt_d, cnt_p, cnt_l in zip(
    population_bin_centers,
    population_empirical_counts_direct,
    population_empirical_counts_process,
    population_empirical_counts_lifespans,
):
    _pop_records += [
        {
            "bin": float(bc),
            "count": int(cnt_d),
            "method": "Observed (from distribution)",
        },
        {"bin": float(bc), "count": int(cnt_p), "method": "Observed (full process)"},
        {
            "bin": float(bc),
            "count": int(cnt_l),
            "method": "Observed (lifespan-at-birth)",
        },
    ]
_pop_df = pd.DataFrame(_pop_records)
_theory_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "bin": population_bin_centers.tolist(),
        "count": population_theoretical_counts.tolist(),
    }
)

_pop_color = alt.Scale(
    domain=[
        "Observed (from distribution)",
        "Observed (full process)",
        "Observed (lifespan-at-birth)",
    ],
    range=[PTOLQUAL[0], PTOLQUAL[2], PTOLQUAL[3]],
)
_pop_bars = (
    alt.Chart(_pop_df)
    .mark_bar(opacity=0.65)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("bin:Q", title="Population size", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 2000])),
        y=alt.Y("count:Q", title="Count"),
        xOffset="method:N",
        color=alt.Color(
            "method:N", scale=_pop_color, legend=alt.Legend(title=None, orient="top")
        ),
    )
)
_theory_line = (
    alt.Chart(_theory_df)
    .mark_line(
        point=alt.OverlayMarkDef(size=25, color=PTOLQUAL[1]),
        strokeDash=[4, 2],
        strokeWidth=2,
        color=PTOLQUAL[1],
    )
    .encode(x=alt.X("bin:Q"), y=alt.Y("count:Q"))
)
fig_population = (_pop_bars + _theory_line).properties(
    title="Population Distribution: Three Methods vs Theory",
    width=600,
    height=350,
)
display(fig_population)
save_chart(
    fig_population, "vse01_population_distribution", width=300, height=200, output_dir=figures_dir
)
print("Saved population figure")
```

## Spine and Non-Spine Age Checks

```{python}
spine_age_samples_direct = np.asarray(
    [
        arr[0]
        for arr in list_of_ages_from_distribution
        if len(arr) > 0 and arr[0] < time_span
    ],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_age_samples_process = np.asarray(
    [
        arr[0]
        for arr in list_of_ages_full_process
        if len(arr) > 0 and arr[0] < time_span
    ],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_age_samples_lifespans = np.asarray(
    [
        arr[0]
        for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans
        if len(arr) > 0 and arr[0] < time_span
    ],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_age_samples_all = np.asarray(
    [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_from_distribution if len(arr) > 0]
    + [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_full_process if len(arr) > 0]
    + [arr[0] for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(arr) > 0],
    dtype=np.float64,
)
spine_prop_not_at_max = proportion_not_at_upper(spine_age_samples_all, time_span)

non_spine_age_samples_direct = (
    np.concatenate([arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_from_distribution if len(arr) > 1])
    if any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_from_distribution)
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_age_samples_process = (
    np.concatenate([arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_full_process if len(arr) > 1])
    if any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_full_process)
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_age_samples_lifespans = (
    np.concatenate([arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(arr) > 1])
    if any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans)
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_age_samples_all = (
    np.concatenate(
        [arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_from_distribution if len(arr) > 1]
        + [arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_full_process if len(arr) > 1]
        + [arr[1:] for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans if len(arr) > 1],
    )
    if (
        any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_from_distribution)
        or any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_full_process)
        or any(len(arr) > 1 for arr in list_of_ages_lifespans)
    )
    else np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
)
non_spine_prop_not_at_max = proportion_not_at_upper(
    non_spine_age_samples_all, time_span
)

spine_grid_process, spine_kde_process = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    spine_age_samples_process,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
spine_grid_direct, spine_kde_direct = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    spine_age_samples_direct,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
spine_grid_lifespans, spine_kde_lifespans = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    spine_age_samples_lifespans,
    support_upper=time_span,
)


def _spine_log_lik(age: float) -> float:
    return calculate_spine_ages_log_lik(
        birth_rates=birth_rate, death_rates=death_rate, ages=age, times=time_span
    )


spine_theory_x, spine_theory_y = theoretical_age_density(
    _spine_log_lik,
    time_span,
    include_endpoint=False,
    proportion_not_at_upper=spine_prop_not_at_max,
)
non_spine_grid_process, non_spine_kde_process = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    non_spine_age_samples_process,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
non_spine_grid_direct, non_spine_kde_direct = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    non_spine_age_samples_direct,
    support_upper=time_span,
)
non_spine_grid_lifespans, non_spine_kde_lifespans = boundary_corrected_kde_on_support(
    non_spine_age_samples_lifespans,
    support_upper=time_span,
)


def _non_spine_log_lik(age: float) -> float:
    return calculate_non_spine_ages_log_lik(
        birth_rates=birth_rate, death_rates=death_rate, ages=age, times=time_span
    )


non_spine_theory_x, non_spine_theory_y = theoretical_age_density(
    _non_spine_log_lik,
    time_span,
    proportion_not_at_upper=non_spine_prop_not_at_max,
)

spine_y_max = robust_y_max(
    [spine_kde_process, spine_kde_direct, spine_kde_lifespans, spine_theory_y]
)
non_spine_y_max = robust_y_max(
    [
        non_spine_kde_process,
        non_spine_kde_direct,
        non_spine_kde_lifespans,
        non_spine_theory_y,
    ]
)


def _kde_panel(
    kde_x: np.ndarray | None,
    kde_y: np.ndarray | None,
    theory_x: np.ndarray,
    theory_y: np.ndarray,
    color: str,
    panel_title: str,
    x_label: str,
    y_label: str,
    y_domain: list[float],
) -> alt.LayerChart:
    x_dom = [0.0, float(time_span)]
    layers: list[alt.Chart] = []
    if kde_x is not None and kde_y is not None:
        kde_df = pd.DataFrame({"Age": kde_x.tolist(), "Density": kde_y.tolist()})
        layers.append(
            alt.Chart(kde_df)
            .mark_area(
                opacity=0.4, color=color, line={"color": color, "strokeWidth": 2}
            )
            .encode(
                x=alt.X("Age:Q", title=x_label, scale=alt.Scale(domain=x_dom)),
                y=alt.Y("Density:Q", title=y_label, scale=alt.Scale(domain=y_domain)),
            )
        )
    theory_df = pd.DataFrame({"Age": theory_x.tolist(), "Density": theory_y.tolist()})
    layers.append(
        alt.Chart(theory_df)
        .mark_line(strokeDash=[4, 2], color=PTOLQUAL[1], strokeWidth=2)
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("Age:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=x_dom)),
            y=alt.Y("Density:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=y_domain)),
        )
    )
    return alt.layer(*layers).properties(title=panel_title, width=280, height=200)


ns_dom = [0.0, non_spine_y_max]
sp_dom = [0.0, spine_y_max]
fig_summary = alt.vconcat(
    alt.hconcat(
        _kde_panel(
            non_spine_grid_process,
            non_spine_kde_process,
            non_spine_theory_x,
            non_spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[2],
            "Full process",
            "Age (full process)",
            "Density (non-spine)",
            ns_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            non_spine_grid_direct,
            non_spine_kde_direct,
            non_spine_theory_x,
            non_spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[0],
            "From distribution",
            "Age (from distribution)",
            "",
            ns_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            non_spine_grid_lifespans,
            non_spine_kde_lifespans,
            non_spine_theory_x,
            non_spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[3],
            "Lifespan-at-birth",
            "Age (lifespan-at-birth)",
            "",
            ns_dom,
        ),
    ),
    alt.hconcat(
        _kde_panel(
            spine_grid_process,
            spine_kde_process,
            spine_theory_x,
            spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[2],
            "Full process",
            "Age (full process)",
            "Density (spine)",
            sp_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            spine_grid_direct,
            spine_kde_direct,
            spine_theory_x,
            spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[0],
            "From distribution",
            "Age (from distribution)",
            "",
            sp_dom,
        ),
        _kde_panel(
            spine_grid_lifespans,
            spine_kde_lifespans,
            spine_theory_x,
            spine_theory_y,
            PTOLQUAL[3],
            "Lifespan-at-birth",
            "Age (lifespan-at-birth)",
            "",
            sp_dom,
        ),
    ),
).properties(title="Age Densities by Generator (Full Process vs From Distribution vs Lifespan-at-birth)")
display(fig_summary)
save_chart(fig_summary, "vse01_age_densities", output_dir=figures_dir)
print("Saved age-density figure")
```

The density of the spine age distribution does not include the point mass at the maximum time span.

## Statistical Goodness-of-Fit Tests

```{python}
# Anderson-Darling test comparing methods
SIMULATION_SEED = 33943  # fixed seed for permutation test reproducibility

ad_method = PermutationMethod(
    n_resamples=1_111, batch=101, rng=np.random.default_rng(SIMULATION_SEED)
)

# Spine age samples: direct vs full process
spine_ad_result = anderson_ksamp(
    [spine_age_samples_direct, spine_age_samples_process],
    variant="midrank",
    method=ad_method,
)
# Spine age samples: direct vs lifespan
spine_ad_lifespan: Any = None
if spine_age_samples_lifespans.size > 0:
    spine_ad_lifespan = anderson_ksamp(
        [spine_age_samples_direct, spine_age_samples_lifespans],
        variant="midrank",
        method=PermutationMethod(
            n_resamples=1_111, batch=101, rng=np.random.default_rng(SIMULATION_SEED + 1)
        ),
    )

# Non-spine age samples: each array holds ~2M points (num_sims simulations'
# worth of survivors), so a 1,111-resample permutation test is both
# impractically slow (the dominant cost of this notebook) and statistically
# unnecessary — the asymptotic midrank p-value is already exact at this N.
non_spine_ad_result: Any = None
if (non_spine_age_samples_direct.size > 0) and (non_spine_age_samples_process.size > 0):
    non_spine_ad_result = anderson_ksamp(
        [non_spine_age_samples_direct, non_spine_age_samples_process],
        variant="midrank",
    )
non_spine_ad_lifespan: Any = None
if (non_spine_age_samples_direct.size > 0) and (
    non_spine_age_samples_lifespans.size > 0
):
    non_spine_ad_lifespan = anderson_ksamp(
        [non_spine_age_samples_direct, non_spine_age_samples_lifespans],
        variant="midrank",
    )

# Population distributions
pop_ad_result = anderson_ksamp(
    [population_sizes_direct, population_sizes_process],
    variant="midrank",
    method=ad_method,
)
pop_ad_lifespan = anderson_ksamp(
    [population_sizes_direct, population_sizes_lifespans],
    variant="midrank",
    method=PermutationMethod(
        n_resamples=1_111, batch=101, rng=np.random.default_rng(SIMULATION_SEED + 2)
    ),
)

# Kolmogorov-Smirnov test comparing methods for age distributions
spine_ks_statistic, spine_ks_pvalue = ks_2samp(
    spine_age_samples_direct, spine_age_samples_process
)
spine_ks_lifespan_stat, spine_ks_lifespan_pval = (
    ks_2samp(spine_age_samples_direct, spine_age_samples_lifespans)
    if spine_age_samples_lifespans.size > 0
    else (None, None)
)

if (non_spine_age_samples_direct.size > 0) and (non_spine_age_samples_process.size > 0):
    non_spine_ks_statistic, non_spine_ks_pvalue = ks_2samp(
        non_spine_age_samples_direct, non_spine_age_samples_process
    )
else:
    non_spine_ks_statistic = None
    non_spine_ks_pvalue = None
if (non_spine_age_samples_direct.size > 0) and (
    non_spine_age_samples_lifespans.size > 0
):
    non_spine_ks_lifespan_stat, non_spine_ks_lifespan_pval = ks_2samp(
        non_spine_age_samples_direct, non_spine_age_samples_lifespans
    )
else:
    non_spine_ks_lifespan_stat = None
    non_spine_ks_lifespan_pval = None

pop_ks_statistic, pop_ks_pvalue = ks_2samp(
    population_sizes_direct, population_sizes_process
)
pop_ks_lifespan_stat, pop_ks_lifespan_pval = ks_2samp(
    population_sizes_direct, population_sizes_lifespans
)

print("=" * 70)
print("ANDERSON-DARLING TESTS (Direct vs Full Process)")
print("=" * 70)
print("\nSpine Ages:")
print(f"  Anderson-Darling statistic: {spine_ad_result.statistic:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {spine_ad_result.pvalue:.6f}")
print(f"  Samples (direct): {len(spine_age_samples_direct)}")
print(f"  Samples (process): {len(spine_age_samples_process)}")

if non_spine_ad_result is not None:
    print("\nNon-Spine Ages:")
    print(f"  Anderson-Darling statistic: {non_spine_ad_result.statistic:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {non_spine_ad_result.pvalue:.6f}")
    print(f"  Samples (direct): {len(non_spine_age_samples_direct)}")
    print(f"  Samples (process): {len(non_spine_age_samples_process)}")

print("\nPopulation Distributions:")
print(f"  Anderson-Darling statistic: {pop_ad_result.statistic:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {pop_ad_result.pvalue:.6f}")
print(f"  Samples: {len(population_sizes_direct)} each")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ANDERSON-DARLING TESTS (Direct vs Lifespan-at-birth)")
print("=" * 70)
if spine_ad_lifespan is not None:
    print("\nSpine Ages:")
    print(f"  Anderson-Darling statistic: {spine_ad_lifespan.statistic:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {spine_ad_lifespan.pvalue:.6f}")
    print(f"  Samples (direct): {len(spine_age_samples_direct)}")
    print(f"  Samples (lifespan): {len(spine_age_samples_lifespans)}")

if non_spine_ad_lifespan is not None:
    print("\nNon-Spine Ages:")
    print(f"  Anderson-Darling statistic: {non_spine_ad_lifespan.statistic:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {non_spine_ad_lifespan.pvalue:.6f}")
    print(f"  Samples (direct): {len(non_spine_age_samples_direct)}")
    print(f"  Samples (lifespan): {len(non_spine_age_samples_lifespans)}")

print("\nPopulation Distributions:")
print(f"  Anderson-Darling statistic: {pop_ad_lifespan.statistic:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {pop_ad_lifespan.pvalue:.6f}")
print(f"  Samples: {len(population_sizes_direct)} each")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("KOLMOGOROV-SMIRNOV TESTS (Direct vs Full Process)")
print("=" * 70)
print("\nSpine Ages:")
print(f"  KS statistic: {spine_ks_statistic:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {spine_ks_pvalue:.6f}")

if non_spine_ks_statistic is not None:
    print("\nNon-Spine Ages:")
    print(f"  KS statistic: {non_spine_ks_statistic:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {non_spine_ks_pvalue:.6f}")

print("\nPopulation Distributions:")
print(f"  KS statistic: {pop_ks_statistic:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {pop_ks_pvalue:.6f}")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("KOLMOGOROV-SMIRNOV TESTS (Direct vs Lifespan-at-birth)")
print("=" * 70)
if spine_ks_lifespan_stat is not None:
    print("\nSpine Ages:")
    print(f"  KS statistic: {spine_ks_lifespan_stat:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {spine_ks_lifespan_pval:.6f}")

if non_spine_ks_lifespan_stat is not None:
    print("\nNon-Spine Ages:")
    print(f"  KS statistic: {non_spine_ks_lifespan_stat:.6f}")
    print(f"  p-value: {non_spine_ks_lifespan_pval:.6f}")

print("\nPopulation Distributions:")
print(f"  KS statistic: {pop_ks_lifespan_stat:.6f}")
print(f"  p-value: {pop_ks_lifespan_pval:.6f}")
```

The Anderson-Darling test evaluates whether two samples come from the same distribution.
Higher p-values (typically > 0.05) suggest the samples are from the same distribution,
while lower p-values suggest significant differences between methods.
All three generators (direct sampling, full process, lifespan-at-birth) should be
statistically indistinguishable under this test when correctly implemented.
